baseline.description: nneonneo's exact proven settings: depth = max(3, distinct-2), cache 2^22 entries

no_cache.description: Cache disabled entirely; isolates how much the transposition table helps at fixed depth

huge_cache.description: Same fixed-depth search as baseline, much larger cache (2^26 entries, ~1GB) to isolate cache-size effect alone

deeper_search.description: depth_bias=1 instead of 2: searches one ply deeper at every tile count than nneonneo's original

corner_15.description: baseline + snake/corner heuristic term, weight=15 (best candidate from prior noisy testing, re-tested now that search is deterministic)

corner_15_huge_cache.description: corner_15 combined with the huge cache, if both individually help this tests whether they stack
